conversation.text: Welcome to Telecom Haiku. Press 1 for English, 2 for Spanish.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Hi, thanks for calling. This is Robert with technical support. How can I help you today?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I'm calling because my service just cut out. I can't even browse right now.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I'm sorry you're experiencing that. Let me look into your account details.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Can you check if the lights on your modem are all green or if any are flashing red?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Have you tried restarting your modem and router? Sometimes that clears things up.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I'm pushing a software update to your modem right now. You should see improvement.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: You should be good to go now.
